svg.text: SHARK SEPTAL GILLS — STRUCTURE & WATER FLOW
Scoliodon-type (requiem shark) · original explanatory line plate · English-labelled
A HEAD & FIVE EXTERNAL GILL SLITS
No bony operculum. Water exits through separate gill slits.
Generalised cross-section; neighbouring septa bound water chamber
Gill filaments attach to septa; unlike teleosts, the septa persist.
Gas exchange occurs across thin, vascular lamellar surfaces
Blood flows opposite to water at exchange surfaces.
Opposing streams favour oxygen uptake across the lamellae.
Filaments on one side of a supporting arch.
Thin, vascular surfaces for gas exchange.
ORIGINAL QA ILLUSTRATION · anatomy schematic, not a specimen dissection or species-specific micrograph
